key_insight: KQFuzz uses codebase knowledge plus LLM-driven generation, fitness evaluation, and two-level mutations to more effectively fuzz quantum libraries.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical testing workflow to improve reliability of quantum software stacks by finding bugs and boosting coverage in real libraries.
method: Builds a knowledge-grounded prompt from the target codebase to generate high-quality quantum seed programs.
Uses fitness-guided evaluation to prioritize promising tests for execution.
Applies two-level mutations to expand test diversity and explore harder execution paths.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, where coverage improved by up to 18.44% and 13 bugs were found, 12 of which were fixed.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and completeness of the extracted codebase knowledge and the target library’s program structure.
paper_title: KQFuzz: Knowledge-Guided Fuzzing for Quantum Libraries via Large Language Models
